## Run 6 — electron-side SdH spot: raw

At the run-5 calibrated region-A point n = +3.2×10¹² cm⁻², D = 0, this is the ascending 0–10 T trace on the sole wired Rxx pair, B_1–B_2. Signed X/I is plotted before any FFT, alongside the measured current and both gate currents. The absolute n scale still uses the top-hBN geometry prior.

outputs.name: stdout
text: data/6: Rxx -32.9..529.6 ohm, I 9.84..9.94 nA, T median 1.249 K, max |X|/sensitivity 0.10

from hera.analysis import resolve_channels
r = run(6)
ch = {x.cid: x for x in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
B = r.col('magnet_field')
I = r.col('sr0_X') / ch['sr0'].gain
R = (r.col('sr1_X') / ch['sr1'].gain) / I
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(10, 6))
ax[0,0].plot(B, R, lw=.8); ax[0,0].set(xlabel='B (T)', ylabel='signed Rxx (ohm)')
ax[0,1].plot(1/B[B>0], R[B>0], lw=.8); ax[0,1].set(xlim=(0,1), xlabel='1/B (1/T)', ylabel='signed Rxx (ohm)')
ax[1,0].plot(B, I*1e9); ax[1,0].set(xlabel='B (T)', ylabel='drain current (nA)')
ax[1,1].plot(B, r.col('k_2400_tg_curr')*1e12, label='TG')
ax[1,1].plot(B, r.col('k_2400_bg_curr')*1e12, label='BG')
ax[1,1].set(xlabel='B (T)', ylabel='gate current (pA)'); ax[1,1].legend()
fig.suptitle('data/6 raw: n_A=+3.2e12 cm^-2, D_A=0, B 0 to 10 T')
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(f"data/6: Rxx {R.min():.1f}..{R.max():.1f} ohm, I {I.min()*1e9:.2f}..{I.max()*1e9:.2f} nA, T median {np.median(r.col('T_sample')):.3f} K, max |X|/sensitivity {np.max(np.abs(r.col('sr1_X')))/50e-6:.2f}")

### Run 6 — frequency read

The signed-Rxx FFT uses 1–10 T and a degree-5 B-space background, through `hera.analysis.sdh_fft`. Compare its peaks with the full-density Onsager frequency only as a scale check: harmonics and the second series CNP region can duplicate tones. The fan must test how each branch moves with density.

outputs.name: stdout

data/6 FFT 1–10 T peaks: 7.8 T, 14.4 T, 22.2 T, 30.0 T, 33.3 T, 36.7 T
Geometry-anchored full-density F_L(3.2e12) = 33.1 T

from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import sdh_fft, luttinger_frequency
r = run(6); ch = {x.cid: x for x in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
B = r.col('magnet_field'); I = r.col('sr0_X')/ch['sr0'].gain
R = (r.col('sr1_X')/ch['sr1'].gain)/I
f, spec = sdh_fft(R[:,None], B, b_range=(1,10), nfft=4096, bg_degree=5, log=False)
y=spec[0]; pk,_=find_peaks(y); pk=[i for i in pk if 3<f[i]<40]
pk=sorted(pk,key=lambda i:-y[i])[:6]
print('data/6 FFT 1–10 T peaks:', ', '.join(f'{f[i]:.1f} T' for i in pk))
print(f"Geometry-anchored full-density F_L(3.2e12) = {luttinger_frequency(3.2e16):.1f} T")
plt.figure(figsize=(7,3.5)); plt.plot(f,y); plt.xlim(0,40); plt.xlabel('SdH frequency (T)'); plt.ylabel('FFT magnitude (arb.)')
for i in pk[:4]: plt.axvline(f[i],ls=':',alpha=.5); plt.text(f[i],y[i],f'{f[i]:.1f}',fontsize=8)
plt.title('data/6 signed Rxx FFT, B=1–10 T'); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## Run 7 — hole-side SdH spot: raw

At the run-5 calibrated region-A point n = −1.2×10¹² cm⁻², D = 0, this is the descending 10–0.3 T trace. Signed X/I, measured current, and both gate currents are shown before spectral interpretation. The hole endpoint is close to the TG operating edge, so the fan cannot extend much farther on this D = 0 line.

outputs.name: stdout

### Run 7 — frequency read and step verdict

The signed-Rxx FFT uses the same 1–10 T window and detrending as run 6. The strong ~4–7 T components on the hole side and ~8–30 T structure on the electron side confirm the device is fan-ready. They do not yet count independent Fermi pockets: both harmonics and the −0.43×10¹² cm⁻² region-B CNP offset from data/5 are live alternatives. **Step 3 verdict: advances to a field–density fan; no stacking call from the spot checks.**

source:
## HERA — Step 4: calibrated D = 0 Landau fan (`landau-fan`)

> **05:25** · landau-fan: D\_A=0, n\_A -1.2..+3.2e12 cm^-2 (111), B 0..10 T (93 rows), Si 0, base T, sr1 500 uV, tau 0.1 s · **ETA ~11:25** (≈6h)

Plan step 4. Runs 6–7 show strong SdH oscillations, but their fixed-density FFT peaks can be harmonics or copies from the second series region (data/5 offset ≈ −0.43×10¹² cm⁻²). A field–density map tests whether branches move as one full-density family, two intrinsic families, or copies with that fixed offset. The only wired four-probe pair is B_1–B_2; the map cannot spatially isolate the two CNP ridges. The region-A calibration from data/5 sets D_A = 0 and n_A = −1.2…+3.2×10¹² cm⁻² (111 points, Δn = 0.04×10¹²); that line spans TG −0.277…+0.984 V and BG −0.465…+1.166 V, inside the committed limits. Absolute n still inherits the 9.5 nm top-hBN geometry prior.

Field ascends 0, 0.5, 1.0, then 1.1…10.0 T at 0.1 T (93 rows). This starts at the handoff's 0 T and ends at 10 T for a possible descending follow-up. Each row co-sweeps TG and BG to hold D_A = 0; Si remains 0. The 0.1 T spacing and 0.04×10¹² density spacing resolve the low-field fan from the run-6/7 onset, while retaining the CNP and both carrier signs. At τ = 0.1 s / 24 dB, the 1 s fast dwell is 10τ. Set sr1 to 500 µV (50 kΩ nominal R full scale at 10 nA) for high-field CNP headroom; the spot-check signals were only 10–12% of 50 µV, so their larger oscillations remain visible at this range. A >1 nA gate-current, <1 nA drain-current, >90% sr1-range, or T>1.5 K guard interrupts the sweep. Gates park at 0 after completion or interruption; the field holds where the run ends. Magnet interrupts do not stop an in-progress ramp on this rig.

Price from data/5 gate map: 4158 points in 81.2 min, ~1.17 s/point at 1 s fast dwell. The 10 T field traverse is 73 min at 0.137 T/min; 10,323 points cost ~3 h 20 m before two-gate co-sets and row overhead. Allowing ~30–50% overhead and the measured 5–10% estimate bias gives **about 6 h**. Checkpoints: first complete 0 T row for leakage, current, and rail; the first few finite-B rows for field tracking and emerging structure; then every ~10 rows (~1 T) to judge branch continuity and whether the map is still discriminating. Stop early on a guard trip, dead/flat channel, or a wash-out by ~3 T, then read actual field and gates before replanning.

# === Step 4: calibrated D_A=0 Landau fan on hardwired B_1-B_2 Rxx ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# Gate B: live committed validators must still match the device card exactly.
def _bounds(p):
    return (float(p.vals._min_value), float(p.vals._max_value))
_expected = [(-0.3, 1.0), (-1.3, 2.0), (-25.0, 25.0), (-25.0, 25.0),
             (-10.0, 10.0), (0.0, 100.0), (0.0, 100.0)]
_params = [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt, dc205.smart_voltage, dc205.voltage,
           magnet.field, heater.sample_setpoint, heater.vaporizer_setpoint]
_actual = [_bounds(p) for p in _params]
print('SAFETIES validators: actual', _actual, 'expected', _expected)
assert _actual == _expected and B_SESSION_CAP == 10.0 and T_SESSION_CAP == 100.0

# Preconditions the fan assumes: base thermometry, zero field/Si, heater off,
# energized magnet output, and the provided hardwired contact configuration.
assert_thermometry_live('T_sample', VTI.temp_logfile_candidates['T_sample'], max_age=15, max_period=12)
assert_thermometry_live('T_vaporizer', VTI.temp_logfile_candidates['T_vaporizer'], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_Ts, _Tv, _B0, _Vsi = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field(), k_si()
_sr, _vr = heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range()
_ps, _out = magnet.persistent_switch_on(), magnet.output_enabled()
_amp, _freq = sr1.amplitude(), sr1.frequency()
print(f'preconditions: T_sample={_Ts:.3f} K [1.0,1.5], T_vap={_Tv:.3f} K [<1.6]; '
      f'B={_B0:+.4f} T [|B|<.02], Si={_Vsi:+.4f} V [0]; heaters={_sr}/{_vr} [0/0]; '
      f'PS/output={_ps}/{_out} [True/True]; drive={_amp:.3f} V at {_freq:.3f} Hz [1 V,13.777 Hz]')
assert 1.0 <= _Ts <= 1.5 and _Tv < 1.6 and abs(_Tv - _Ts) < 0.6
assert abs(_B0) < 0.02 and abs(_Vsi) < 0.01 and _sr == _vr == 0
assert _ps and _out and abs(_amp - 1.0) < 0.01 and abs(_freq - 13.777) < 0.01
assert WIRING == {'source':'T_0','drain':'B_3','sr1+':'B_1','sr1-':'B_2',
                  'sr2+':'n.c.','sr2-':'n.c.','sr3+':'n.c.','sr3-':'n.c.'}
assert k_tg.volt.step == 0.005 and k_bg.volt.step == 0.005
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1

# data/5 ridge-A ratio + offset; top-gate absolute capacitance from geometry.
FAN_CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-3, c_bg=2.161e-3, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.linspace(-1.2, 3.2, 111)  # units: 1e12 cm^-2
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros_like(n_vec), **FAN_CAL)
B_vec = np.r_[0.0, 0.5, 1.0, np.round(np.arange(1.1, 10.0001, 0.1), 3)]
assert len(B_vec) == 93 and len(Vtg_vec) == len(Vbg_vec) == 111
assert np.all((TG_MIN <= Vtg_vec) & (Vtg_vec <= TG_MAX))
assert np.all((BG_MIN <= Vbg_vec) & (Vbg_vec <= BG_MAX))
assert np.all((0 <= B_vec) & (B_vec <= B_SESSION_CAP))
_n_back, _D_back = calc_nD(Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec, **FAN_CAL)
assert np.max(np.abs(_n_back - n_vec)) < 1e-8 and np.max(np.abs(_D_back)) < 1e-8
print(f'fan vectors: B {B_vec[0]:.1f}..{B_vec[-1]:.1f} T x {len(B_vec)} rows; '
      f'n_A {n_vec[0]:+.2f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 x {len(n_vec)} pts, D_A=0; '
      f'TG {Vtg_vec.min():+.4f}..{Vtg_vec.max():+.4f} V, BG {Vbg_vec.min():+.4f}..{Vbg_vec.max():+.4f} V')

# Fixed acquisition settings: 1 s = 10 tau at 24 dB. The current channel has
# enough headroom at 20 mV; the voltage channel has 50 kOhm nominal headroom.
sr0.time_constant(0.1); sr1.time_constant(0.1)
sr1.sensitivity(500e-6)
_s1fs = sr1.sensitivity()
print(f'acquisition: sr0/sr1 tau {sr0.time_constant()}/{sr1.time_constant()} s, '
      f'slopes {sr0.filter_slope()}/{sr1.filter_slope()} dB/oct, sr1 FS {_s1fs*1e6:.0f} uV')
assert sr0.filter_slope() == sr1.filter_slope() == 24

mc = dict(meas_config)
mc['Si (V)'] = _Vsi; mc['sample_temperature:'] = _Ts
mc['comments'] = ('landau-fan: run-5 calibrated D_A=0; n_A -1.2..+3.2e12/0.04e12; '
                  'B 0,0.5,1.0,1.1..10.0/0.1 T; 1 s fast dwell; sr1 500 uV; Si 0')
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment('B slow 0,0.5,1.0,1.1..10.0 T (93 rows); n_A fast -1.2..+3.2e12 cm^-2 '
              '(111 pts, D_A=0, co-swept TG/BG); Si=0; T=base; region-A cal data/5: '
              'c_tg=2.796mF/m2, c_bg=2.161mF/m2, n_offset=-0.0894e12, D_offset=-0.013V/nm; '
              'sr1=500uV, tau=0.1s, fast_delay=1s; contacts T_0->B_3, Rxx B_1-B_2')

# Park the fast pair at the first density endpoint before the run starts.
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, float(Vbg_vec[0])); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, float(Vtg_vec[0]))
interruptible_sleep(10)

# Row: time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, I_tg, I_bg, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P.
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
for _y in [T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]:
    s.plot(k_tg.volt, _y)

def fan_guard(station, data):
    _it, _ib = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    _ix, _vx, _t = abs(float(data[7])), abs(float(data[9])), float(data[4])
    if _it > 1e-9 or _ib > 1e-9 or _ix < 1e-3 or _vx > 0.9*_s1fs or _t > 1.5:
        print(f'FAN GUARD TRIP B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}, '
              f'Vbg={float(data[3]):+.4f}: I_tg={_it:.3e}, I_bg={_ib:.3e} A, '
              f'sr0.X={_ix:.3e} V, sr1.X/FS={_vx/_s1fs:.2f}, T={_t:.3f} K')
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(fan_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt],
                     [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec], slow_delay=1.0, fast_delay=1.0)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0.0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0.0)
    print(f'fan exit readback: B={magnet.field():+.4f} T, TG={k_tg.volt():+.4f} V, '
          f'BG={k_bg.volt():+.4f} V, Si={k_si():+.4f} V, T={T_sample():.3f} K')

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0                       # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V; "
      f"roundtrip n,D = {calc_nD(Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot, CAL['c_tg'], CAL['c_bg'], CAL['n_offset'], CAL['D_offset'])}")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
